mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (board_title, board_content, board_writer_id, board_like_count, board_view_count, board_write_date) VALUES (#{board_title}, #{board_content}, #{board_writer_id}, #{board_like_count}, #{board_view_count}, #{board_write_date})
mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id, b.board_title, b.board_writer_id, ba.board_adopt_category FROM board b INNER JOIN board_adopt ba ON b.board_id = ba.board_id WHERE b.board_id=15
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_question (board_id, answer_selected, board_question_category) VALUES (#{board_id}, #{answer_selected}, #{board_question_category})
INSERT INTO board_adopt (board_id, board_adopt_category, board_adopt_done) VALUES (#{board_id}, #{board_adopt_category}, #{board_adopt_done})
